question: Does the source-defined fresh HTII-280-sorted GSM4522986 preparation provide measurable ERBB4 and ERBB2 RNA context?
decision: Correct the v1 figure legend overlap and label barcode counts explicitly, preserving all numerical outputs and the original frozen image.
strongest_rival: A legend obscuring measured bars or an ambiguous n label can cause visual misreading of a single-preparation RNA description.
discriminator: Use the unchanged frozen four-row summary; position legend outside axes and explicitly label barcodes and single-library limitations.
exposure_record: All v1 results and the v1 image have been seen. This fully exposed presentation correction changes no scientific estimate, threshold, eligibility or interpretation.
biological_unit: One source-defined deposited library/preparation GSM4522986; original donor identity unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Barcodes are nested within one preparation; deposited and operational-QC subsets overlap. Shared source with Kathiriya/Lin/Gomez is not independent replication. No donor pairing or biological replicate count is inferred.
population_and_selection: Only source-labelled fresh HTII-280-sorted GSM4522986. All deposited barcodes and one fixed operational-QC subset: positive depth, 200-6000 detected features inclusive and <=10 percent mitochondrial UMI. No state assignment.
contrast: Plot the same two genes and same two nested subsets from the completed v1 summary; no new scientific contrast or recalculation.
endpoint: Exactly ERBB4 and ERBB2 RNA UMI totals; per-gene full-feature CPM, positive-barcode count/fraction, and both-target co-detection count/fraction. Full recovered RNA denominator is all source features.
methods: Read frozen receptor_summary.csv; render a two-panel detection/CPM figure with outside legend and explicit barcode/unit labels. No raw matrix or biological recalculation.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain every deposited barcode, QC exclusion reasons, zero-depth and unknown-state/donor status. Undefined ratios are NA, never zero. Missing/ambiguous targets or parity failure stops. Eight mixed libraries are not analyzed; state comparisons for all nine remain unestimated.
multiplicity: Two prespecified targets, two nested subsets, all four rows retained; no inferential tests or selected cutoff sensitivities.
precision_basis: One preparation supplies exact descriptive recovered counts, not population precision. No independent donor replication, cell-based confidence interval, power calculation or effect margin.
interpretation_limit: Source-defined sorted origin is not certified pure AT2 state. RNA detection is not protein, receptor activity/assembly, NRG1 response, IL-1 specificity, lineage or repair. Sparse or zero counts are not biological absence.
stop_rule: Stop on input hash mismatch, unexpected row count/order or rendering failure; retain original frozen image and unchanged numerical tables.
amendment_reason: Presentation-only correction after visual review: legend overlapped detection bars. New figure supersedes the v1 rendering for display; no biological analysis is rerun.
